rules.lightBackground: Use the primary cream-tile artwork for light or mixed surfaces.
rules.darkBackground: Use the navy-tile alternate for dark, colored, or photographic surfaces.
rules.chevrons: The lower chevron is retired. The upper chevron is 10% smaller than the original, deep dark navy on cream and cream on navy, with identical approved geometry and 3D treatment.
rules.robot: Both variants use the same crooked-smile robot. It uses the alternate tile's darkest core navy—not the former medium blue—on cream and the original cream color on navy.
rules.aspectRatio: Always preserve the original 1:1 aspect ratio.
